description: Returns a link to the Cuecaps studio set up with these caption settings, and the steps to give the user: they open it, add their video, click Find words and export an MP4 with captions burned in, a transparent overlay or an SRT or VTT file. With fast, the link also turns on Fast edit as soon as the words are found, cutting dead space, filler words and retakes, punching in on the jump cuts and levelling the volume. The video stays on their device. Works on every plan, Free included; exporting with Fast edit comes with Creator and Pro.

aspect.description: Frame shape: 9:16 for TikTok, Shorts and Reels, 1:1 or 4:5 for feed posts, 16:9 for YouTube.

fast.description: Fast edit tools to turn on once the words are found: deadspace cuts the pauses, fillers cuts um, uh and stutters, retakes keeps the last take of a restarted sentence, zoom punches in on the jump cuts, norm levels the volume to -14 LUFS. all turns on every one.

lang.description: The spoken language. Give it for any video that isn't in English; auto lets cloud transcription detect it.

position.description: Where the captions sit in the frame.

style.description: Caption style. list_styles shows how each one looks.

words.description: Words per caption; 1 shows one word at a time.

name: studio_link
